name: Mechanical Failures
author: Matias
description: Realistic engine problems for you and the AI, built on the game's own engine simulation: oil and water leaks, overheating, valve and fuel-pressure faults, exhaust cracks and blow-ups. Problems build up over minutes with dashboard warnings, smoke, sounds and new engineer radio calls, so you can nurse the car home or pit. Follows the game's Mechanical Failures option (none = off).
